outline: This course emphasizes the stead state, time, and frequency analysis of vehicle dynamics. Vehicle Models including plane and space motions will be detailed deduced. The application and development of these models to vehicle performance, handling and ride will be discussed. The effects of suspension, steering geometry, and tyre mechanics on handling are also covered.

3.Tyre Mechanics
4.Tyre Mechanics

14.Time and Frequency Response

16.Steering System Dynamics
17.3 d.o.f. Steady-State Motion
